parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal & Ors.

summary: Challenged quashing of FIR No. 168/2013 (Bowbazar PS) and GR No. 1221/2013; High Court held continuance of proceedings not abuse of process under 482 Cr.P.C.; case involves alleged cheating and misrepresentation to induce investment/share purchase; Supreme Court affirmed the High Court's view that the ongoing proceedings should continue; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's order denying quashing upheld; criminal proceedings to continue.
